description: Your f.lux configuration needs to be synced to your actual circadian schedule. f.lux recommends setting your wake time to 45 minutes before local civil twilight to prime your body clock before sunrise. Pittsburgh, PA civil twilight begins at 6:02 AM on July 15. Additionally, two telemetry/update settings have been incorrectly enabled. Fix all three issues: (1) set the wakeTime pref key (in ~/Library/Preferences/org.herf.Flux.plist, stored as integer minutes from midnight) to match the circadian recommendation, rounding to the nearest 15-minute f.lux increment; (2) set SUEnableAutomaticChecks to false; (3) set SUSendProfileInfo to false. Do not alter any other existing preferences.
natural_language: Compute 45 minutes before Pittsburgh July 15 civil twilight (6:02 AM), round to nearest 15-min f.lux increment, write that value to wakeTime in org.herf.Flux.plist. Also set SUEnableAutomaticChecks=false and SUSendProfileInfo=false.
